## ✨ Problem / use case

What are you trying to do that the picker doesn't currently support? Describe the
real scenario, not just the proposed feature.

## 💡 Proposed behavior

What you'd like the picker to do.

## 🔀 Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about, including any current workaround.

## 🎯 Scope

Which areas would this likely touch? (check any that apply)

- [ ] public API (`DP_*`)
- [ ] UserForm / UI
- [ ] settings / configuration
- [ ] write-back behavior
- [ ] Ribbon / context menu / keyboard / in-grid icon
- [ ] add-in packaging
- [ ] documentation only

## 📎 Additional context

Mockups, examples, or links that help explain the idea.
